outcome.answer: The closest matches are [2] and [5]. [2] targets bias in LLM-based recommender systems by turning debiasing into an efficient machine unlearning task, estimating and removing the influence of bias-inducing samples without costly retraining. [5] also focuses on debiasing without direct sensitive labels, using post-hoc concept and attribute erasure from textual profiles. [1] is related too, but it is about unlearning a user’s data in recommendation systems while preserving recommendation quality, not general prejudice removal in suggestion engines.
